text:
The night was Dantesque... In the midst of muteness

suddenly broke the rumbling of thunder...

A troop of colts that had broken the bit

and hurled itself, untamed, into the abyss...


A pale glare of cataclysm,

the sky that before had shown itself serene,

sinisterly illuminated in full,

as if the sky itself were burning...


Amid a thousand convulsions of mountain

the red and throbbing entrail opened

on that bitter night of hardship...


And from the crater in the open wound

burst the burning lava, enraged,

like a boa burning with lust.

translation.title: Quezaltepec
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the volcanic sonnet's dramatic animal force.
